messages.author: 9f9d8faa8c5f37e7
messages.subject: Backwards compatible version of gbm
parts: I've noticed that the CRAN version of gbm has been slightly updated and recently orphaned. Given all the good, but breaking changes in the 2.2 series, is there any objection to keeping a separate backwards compatible version on CRAN? In a similar spirit to lme4.0 perhaps? I wouldn't mind maintaining it, but not if this was already in the works.
